section_summary.extract_value: This section describes one study (Study X) conducted between September 2014 and October 2015 that recruited only female, Dutch-fluent participants from two universities in the Netherlands. Data were collected via an online survey (participants received a survey link); participants chose compensation and provided electronic consent, and the study received ethics approval. The section does not report sample size, participant ages, race/ethnicity, education percentages, BMI data, assessment instruments (BAS/BAS-2), or correlations between body appreciation and BMI.
